templates.description: TypeScript library with Bun, tsdown, Biome, and Changesets
instructions: Create a GitHub repository for this project:
Install these GitHub Apps on your new repo:
Enable GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests:
In GitHub, go to Actions -> General.
Under Workflow permissions, enable Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests.
If the checkbox is disabled, enable it in your organization Actions settings first.
Publish the first release manually to set up npm trusted publishing:
Set the package name in package.json first.
Then connect the package to .github/workflows/publish.yml in npm package settings.
